description: HAP Q (HapY) decode + YCoCg shader path regression gate. Loads a tiny HapY (scaled-YCoCg in BC3) .mov fixture, seeks to a known frame, hashes the compose target. Verifies that (1) HAPDecoder routes HapY content with TextureColorSpace::YCoCg_scaled, (2) the colour-space hint flows VideoTexture -> drawTexturedQuad -> LayerConstants, (3) sampleLayerTexture in common.hlsli undoes HAP Q's scaled-YCoCg encoding before composition. Distinct golden from hap_roundtrip (Hap5) — if the YCoCg path regresses to plain RGBA sampling these hashes will not match. Fixture generated via `generate_hap_fixture <dst> hap_q 64 64 16 30`; same gradient pattern as test_media/hap_gradient/.
